title: Parity approximation from BLR acceptance
statement: Let $f:\\{−1,1\\}^n\\to\\{−1,1\\}$ and $\\eta\\in\\mathbb R$. If the sign-valued BLR tester accepts $f$ with probability at least $1-\\eta$, then some parity function on the cube differs from $f$ on at most an $\\eta$ fraction of inputs.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
The tester's acceptance probability on $f$ is at least $1-\\eta$
